payload.comment: Ingestion stage is internally consistent. Dataset manifest and run manifest agree on dataset name (pathmnist), schema version (1.0), and split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) match official sizes with no subsampling. All integrity hashes (archive MD5, per-split SHA256) are present. Deterministic mode is enabled with seed 42. No deterministic findings to address. Minor note: created_at timestamp (2026-09-08) is in the future relative to typical wall-clock, likely a system clock artifact; does not affect pipeline correctness. Ready to proceed to next stage.
